lines.text: Many learners say: She is married with a doctor.
Better: She is married to a doctor.
Say married to. Not married with.
To! He is married to my sister.

data.wrong: She is married with a doctor.
data.right: She is married to a doctor.
data.why: Say married to. Not married with.

native.tip: “和某人结婚”要说 “be married to”，不是 married with。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “She is married with a doctor.”？😅 “和某人结婚”要用 be married to：“She is married to a doctor.”。跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“married to”。结婚用 married to！免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Say “be married to” someone, not “married with”.
en.caption: Do you say “She is married with a doctor.”? 😅 To say who you are married to, use be married to: “She is married to a doctor.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
